items.source: Create a new PrometheusPushGatewayManager instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的PrometheusPushGatewayManager实例。

items.source: Shutdown the manager, running any PrometheusPushGatewayManager.ShutdownOperation.
items.translation: 关闭管理器，运行任何 PrometheusPushGatewayManager.ShutdownOperation。

items.source: Class that can be used to manage the pushing of metrics to a Prometheus PushGateway. Handles the scheduling of push operations, error handling and shutdown operations.
items.translation: 可用于管理将指标推送到 `Prometheus PushGateway` 的类。处理推送操作的调度、错误处理和关闭操作。

items.source: pushRate - the rate at which push operations occur
shutdownOperation - the shutdown operation that should be performed when context is closed
items.translation: shutdownOperation - 在关闭上下文时应执行的关闭操作

items.source: David J. M. Karlsen, Phillip Webb
items.translation: David J. M. Karlsen, Phillip Webb

items.source: The operation that should be performed on shutdown.
items.translation: 应在关闭时执行的操作。
